evidence.s1: Now, Places and Today retain contrasting ink in all four light/dark phases; the record separates source means, footprint hints and measured body levels.
evidence.s2: The light/dark first view has three task units: Now, Places and Today, with search and photograph controls as ornaments.
evidence.s3: The record gives thickness 8 throughout and window/module spans of at least 320 px; the smaller search and photograph ornaments remain legible in both schemes.
evidence.s4: The valley fills the viewport and remains visible around all three windows in both schemes and every Today scroll capture.
evidence.s5: The record declares regular only, and the three windows and two ornaments maintain one material family in light and dark.
evidence.s6: No clear glass is used on the windows, search or photograph platter in either scheme; the record explicitly excludes it.
evidence.s7: Search, place links, tasks and photograph controls carry no coloured tint in either scheme.
evidence.s8: The light windows visibly transmit the photograph and the record identifies runtime material on both tiers; solid policy panels appear only in accessibility states.
evidence.s9: The windows use fixed rounded corners, search and the closed Photograph are capsules, and the record derives child radii from their parents.
evidence.s10: Places tiles sit evenly inside the rounded window in both schemes, with recorded radius 12 from the 32 px parent minus its 20 px inset.
evidence.s11: Search and Photograph are capsules in light, dark and CSS captures, while dense place tiles use rounded rectangles.
evidence.s12: Search is one housing and Photograph a separate housing; neither ornament adds unrelated controls or more than three bar groups.
evidence.s13: Search has a non-button glyph and Photograph a non-button chevron; no separate icon button shares either text control’s glass in light or dark.
evidence.s14: Search and Photograph read as whole material-backed controls in both schemes, with plain input, glyph and label children.
evidence.s15: The twelve Places links share one window, while the three task windows remain deliberately separated by broad photograph gaps in both schemes.
evidence.s16: Today’s middle and bottom captures move only its child content, with inner-edge fading while its header, glass outline and other ornaments stay fixed in both schemes.
evidence.s17: Cloud banks, fields, the dawn ridge and the night star field sit behind the glass footprints; no phase leaves the windows as invisible outlines.
evidence.s18: Text remains readable across the light/dark phases; the record’s worst ordinary line is the dark dawn Search placeholder at 4.81:1.
evidence.s19: The reduced-transparency view preserves the tasks and controls; the record reports contrast/motion checks and a live Reduce Motion flip settling to a usable focused trigger.
evidence.s20: The windows show material rather than added host panels in normal light/dark views; the record grades the environment itself and confines authored fills to children.
evidence.s21: unread: the light/dark Photograph captures show closed and open endpoints, but neither captures nor record establish pointer-local glow and flex during a press.
evidence.s22: Search, weather symbols, place initials, tasks and photograph controls are monochrome in both schemes; colour belongs to the photographs.
evidence.s23: Dark labels on light glass and light labels on dark glass remain distinct from the orange dusk, green day and blue night content.
evidence.s24: Now contains large figures rather than prose, while Today and Places use weighted ink; the record gates rendered body lines and confines tertiary ink to a hairline.
evidence.s25: Places links and the current Today event use lighter interactive child fills, without nested glass hosts, in both schemes.
evidence.s26: Search hangs above Places and Photograph below Now without overlap; the record names their overlay groups and runtime-derived 63 px gap.
evidence.s27: The open Photograph platter contains small opaque framed thumbnails rather than window-sized imagery; the record derives their frame radius from the platter.
evidence.s28: No coloured accent appears on lightweight text or thin marks in the windows or ornaments in either scheme.
evidence.s29: The windows are untinted in the record, and their changing peach, green and blue bodies visibly follow the environment rather than a brand fill.
evidence.s30: CSS captures preserve the layout and forced colours preserve weather and task marks; the record gives collapsed 568768 px at DPR 1, a two-layer 390610 px read, and uncalibrated window scale.
